target: KTT positivity conjecture LR(iv): a stretched LR polynomial P(n)=c(n*nu;n*lam,n*mu) with a strictly negative monomial coefficient. Tier-0 route: a hive polytope Q with h*_d > h*_1 (JACKPOT), in particular c = d+1 with an interior lattice point (TIER0).
family: EXHAUSTIVE census, r = #parts(nu) = 5 exactly, |nu| <= 26, ALL triples (lam,mu,nu) with |lam|+|mu|=|nu|

enumeration.nu: every partition of N into EXACTLY 5 positive parts, N = 5..26 -> 1346 partitions nu
enumeration.lam_mu: every pair of partitions with |lam|+|mu|=|nu| and lam subset nu, mu subset nu
enumeration.symmetry_folded: lam <-> mu (c(nu;lam,mu) = c(nu;mu,lam) => identical P, d, h*, so the mirror triple carries an identical record)

containment_restriction.statement: c(nu;lam,mu) != 0  =>  lam subset nu and mu subset nu (exact LR theorem); the excluded triples have Q empty and contribute only to the EMPTY bucket

VERDICT PASS.

instrument.arithmetic: exact int / Fraction only; no float decides anything
instrument.per_triple_cost: D+3 = 9 exact engine-A evaluations at n = 0..8 (D = (r-1)(r-2)/2 = 6), exact Newton interpolation through n=0..6, two held-out points n=7,8, exact h*

min_hstar1_minus_hstar_d.note: EXACT integer; the exhaustive frontier. Never negative anywhere in the census.

max_hstar_d.note: d = 1, where h*_1 = h*_d identically, so margin 0 is forced and no JACKPOT is possible.

structural_findings: THE BLOCKING MECHANISM AT r=5, |nu|<=26 IS NOT BOUNDARY-POINT COUNT, IT IS EMPTINESS OF THE INTERIOR. Every one of the 261,421 records with d >= 3 has h*_d = 0, i.e. the hive polytope has NO relative-interior lattice point at all. TIER0 requires h*_d > 0, so it is unreachable in this range for the trivial reason that the interior is lattice-point-free.

Interior lattice points exist only at d <= 2 in this range: 10,404 records at d=1 (h*_d in {1,2}) and 71 records at d=2 (h*_d = 1). At d = 1, h*_1 = h*_d identically, so the margin is 0 by force and JACKPOT is impossible; at d = 2 every such record has h*_1 >= 1.

975,039 records realise h*_1 = 0 (c = d+1, the exact left half of the TIER0 condition), including 27,354 at d = 4 and 4,816 at d = 5. All 975,039 have h*_d = 0. So the c = d+1 population is abundant and is killed entirely by the second half of the condition.
All 992 full-dimensional records (d = D = 6) have h*_d = 0 -- consistent with, and locally stronger than, Theorem 1 (full-dimensional + interior lattice point => B >= 2d).
At d = 6, h*_1 >= 1 always (minimum c = 8 = d+2), and the observed h*_1 values are 1,3,5,6,7,... -- h*_1 = 2 and h*_1 = 4 never occur.

0 violations of h*_d <= h*_1, Stanley monotonicity, Hibi lower bound, or Stanley nonnegativity, over all 2,815,927 nonempty records. No record in this family certifies non-latticeness from its Ehrhart data.

verification.policy: any TIER0 / JACKPOT / NEGATIVE record is re-verified with engine B over the full profile plus an INDEPENDENT (Lagrange, not Newton) interpolation and an independent h* recomputation, then reciprocity-checked
verification.frontier_verification_result: 4/4 CONFIRMED -- engine A profile == engine B profile == screen profile; Lagrange coefficients reproduce both held-out points; independent h* equals the screen h*; (-1)^d P(-1) equals h*_d

honesty: A null census is NOT evidence for the King-Tollu-Toumazet conjecture and is not described as such here. This run exhausts one finite family; it decides nothing about the conjecture.
